SapphireAdobe.eaDisplayName: Boris FX Sapphire for Adobe Version
SapphireAdobe.notes: Not in Jamf's built-in patch catalog (checked jamf-patch.jamfcloud.com/v1/software, 1587 titles, 2026-11-19) or official Patch Management Software Titles list. Inspected official Adobe macOS installers SapphireAEInstall-2027.dmg (CFBundleVersion 20.0, CFBundleShortVersionString 'Version 2027', bundle ID com.genarts.SapphireAE.plugins in year-specific /Applications/BorisFX/Sapphire 2027 Adobe) and SapphireAEInstall-2026.52.dmg (CFBundleVersion 19.52, ShortVersion 'Version 2026.52', folder Sapphire 2026.5 Adobe). Application Version is not unique across patches, so detection is an EA that reads CFBundleVersion (matches official catalog 'version' field, not display_version 2027.0.0). Checker uses the public Boris FX downloads catalog.
